scope: Detector component ablation on a fixed 6,000-sample out-of-fold dataset

recovery_stage.purpose: Quantify the recall-oriented contributions of targeted evidence and the consistency signal on the fixed out-of-fold dataset.

recall_matched_veto.purpose: Evaluate false-alarm suppression at unchanged observed recall.
recall_matched_veto.matching_rule: For each target, fix the exact TP count of the base detector. Among the available base+model+veto candidate policies with the same TP, select the candidate with minimum FP; ties are resolved deterministically.
recall_matched_veto.note: This is an operating-point comparison over already-generated OOF candidate policies. No new VLA inference or detector fitting is performed.

main_ablation_structure.4: Conservative veto evaluated at the same observed recall as the base detector

important_interpretation: Rows 1-3 form a cumulative recall-oriented ablation. Row 4 is a recall-matched operating-point ablation for the veto and should not be interpreted as a direct cumulative continuation of row 3.
